### 2026-10-11 – 9, 10 and 11 of Octomber.

**7.2h**

9, 10 and 11 of Octomber.
Hello yall! I have made this journal because I have not timelapsed these parts.
So first I have the time spent on searching and researching all the necessary parts and components for the PCB, which took... a while... this was on the small portion of the 8th and on the 9th.
On the 10 and 11th I have made the docs/README, the BOM (searched each part and how much it costs), I have also made the reel/edit, which it had to be done (I make car edits and whatnot so yeah, im the best there is.)
The longest was the README + the BOM, which took about 4 and a half, 5 hours, maybe a bit more but I am lowballing it a bit, and the researching, the BOM, finishes on the schematic, and everything else miscellaneous the rest of the time.
